bio.text: Justin Pearson, a Democrat from Memphis, represents District 86 (part of Shelby County) in the Tennessee House of Representatives and is the Democratic nominee for U.S. House in Tennessee's 9th District in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is also on the ballot for re-election to his state House seat.

The Shelby County Commission appointed him as an acting legislator on January 24, 2023, and he was elected in a March 14, 2023 special election; the House voted to expel him on April 6, 2023, and the Shelby County Commission reinstated him on April 12, 2023.
He graduated from Mitchell High School and has worked as a community organizer.
